why: Reports callback time as the frame interval. Main-thread work is usually far shorter than the frame, so a device that drops frames would read as smooth.
killedBy: buildBenchReport summarizes intervals as frames and callback time as work, never the other way round

startGameWith: the dev console surface the benchmark measures a session without changing what it simulates (issue #734) reports the session it measured, the rAF intervals the frames were fired at, and the preset cap
